system_overview: fleet-fuel-tracker is a fuel receipt tracking for a delivery fleet with OCR import. It is built as a small focused system with Receipt OCR (Tesseract) at its core, supported by Trip Matcher and Fraud Flagger.

recommended_language.rationale: Go fits the fuel receipt tracking for a delivery fleet with OCR import workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Receipt OCR (Tesseract) as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The fuel receipt tracking for a delivery fleet with OCR import hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Fraud Flagger asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Vehicle, Receipt, Trip must persist relationally
Components: Receipt OCR (Tesseract), Trip Matcher, Fraud Flagger
